title: NOVEL-100: 100 new capabilities N01..N100 (0 done, 2 built-not-tested, 98 not yet)

items.text: Berry-phase clock: tells subjective time of day from the geometric phase its internal qubit accumulates over the day loop
items.category: NOVEL-100 / A. Quantum and geometric interior

items.text: Quantum-metric surprise: Fubini–Study distance between successive qubit states is a surprise signal that drives attention
items.category: NOVEL-100 / A. Quantum and geometric interior

items.text: Topological moods: mood states labelled by an integer (Chern-like) invariant of the internal state, so they flip only at topological transitions
items.category: NOVEL-100 / A. Quantum and geometric interior

items.text: Quantum-metric plasticity: synaptic updates preconditioned by the QGT of its own state (natural gradient inside a living creature)
items.category: NOVEL-100 / A. Quantum and geometric interior

items.text: Chance literacy: learns to tell world events driven by Moonlab dice from PRNG-driven ones, and only where they differ
items.category: NOVEL-100 / A. Quantum and geometric interior

items.text: Chosen randomness: picks the measurement basis of its own qubit as an action, shaping how random its next choice is
items.category: NOVEL-100 / A. Quantum and geometric interior

items.text: Order-effect decisions: options interfere in its decision state, so the order it considers them changes the choice
items.category: NOVEL-100 / A. Quantum and geometric interior

items.text: Quantum-path sleep pressure: sleep need grows with the quantum-metric path length its state travelled that day
items.category: NOVEL-100 / A. Quantum and geometric interior

items.text: Thought-curvature metacognition: intrinsic curvature of its neural state trajectory triggers a metacognitive check and workspace re-ignition
items.category: NOVEL-100 / A. Quantum and geometric interior

items.text: Geodesic imagination: plans by following geodesics on its own learned neural manifold, so thought detours around "conceptual obstacles"
items.category: NOVEL-100 / A. Quantum and geometric interior

items.text: Self-surgery with the lab's own lesion tool: chooses couplings to cut or boost from its self-model's prediction
items.category: NOVEL-100 / B. Self-modification by its own choice

items.text: Self-steering: injects stimulation into its own regions to set its mood before a hard task
items.category: NOVEL-100 / B. Self-modification by its own choice

items.text: Free won't: reads its own motor-lens prediction and vetoes predicted bad actions
items.category: NOVEL-100 / B. Self-modification by its own choice

items.text: Self circuit discovery in sleep: runs a lesion search on its own wiring while asleep and protects the couplings it finds critical
items.category: NOVEL-100 / B. Self-modification by its own choice

items.text: Creature-initiated save points: stores a partial snapshot before a risky act and restores chosen parts after injury, paying energy
items.category: NOVEL-100 / B. Self-modification by its own choice

items.text: Identity audit: measures how much of its own hidden state survived since yesterday and grows cautious when identity drift is high
items.category: NOVEL-100 / B. Self-modification by its own choice

items.text: Self-preregistration: commits a hash of its prediction before acting, checks it afterwards and penalises its own overconfidence
items.category: NOVEL-100 / B. Self-modification by its own choice

items.text: Plasticity auction: brain regions bid energy for the right to learn, and the creature decides where learning happens
items.category: NOVEL-100 / B. Self-modification by its own choice

items.text: Deliberate forgetting: chooses to erase memories that keep driving costly false alarms
items.category: NOVEL-100 / B. Self-modification by its own choice

items.text: Organ re-budgeting by vote: organs negotiate their energy share via interoceptive signals, and the brain arbitrates
items.category: NOVEL-100 / B. Self-modification by its own choice

items.text: Substrate sense: detects whether its rules run on the Eshkol VM, TS or RV32I from timing/rounding signatures, and acts on it
items.category: NOVEL-100 / C. Simulation and substrate awareness

items.text: Physics-constant tracking: continuously estimates the current gravity, temperature and time-dilation dial values as latent variables
items.category: NOVEL-100 / C. Simulation and substrate awareness

items.text: Conservation-anomaly sense: senses where energy is not conserved (anomaly dial) and avoids or exploits those zones
items.category: NOVEL-100 / C. Simulation and substrate awareness

items.text: Déjà vu on replay: a restored creature recognises it is re-living an exact replay and exploits its foreknowledge
items.category: NOVEL-100 / C. Simulation and substrate awareness

items.text: Universe-load sense: senses compute-tick jitter as a bodily signal ("fatigue of the world")
items.category: NOVEL-100 / C. Simulation and substrate awareness

items.text: Signalling the experimenter: learns which displays tend to be followed by God-panel changes and uses them
items.category: NOVEL-100 / C. Simulation and substrate awareness

items.text: Wall probing after anomalies: explores the dome's limits more after witnessing physics anomalies
items.category: NOVEL-100 / C. Simulation and substrate awareness

items.text: Nested-dome self-location: infers which level of nested domes it lives in from physics differences
items.category: NOVEL-100 / C. Simulation and substrate awareness

items.text: Respawn self-knowledge: a respawned creature detects that it is a respawn (blank history) and seeks elders to learn from
items.category: NOVEL-100 / C. Simulation and substrate awareness

items.text: Lab-probe accounting: knows the cost each lab instrument adds to its ledger and budgets around inspection
items.category: NOVEL-100 / C. Simulation and substrate awareness

items.text: Field sense of its own brain: reads its own 3D neural-activity field as a sense organ (interoception of thought)
items.category: NOVEL-100 / D. Senses beyond the usual

items.text: Peer field reading: senses a peer's neural-activity field at contact range and predicts its next action
items.category: NOVEL-100 / D. Senses beyond the usual

items.text: Sleep-pressure smell: senses peers' adenosine level and times approaches to their drowsiness
items.category: NOVEL-100 / D. Senses beyond the usual

items.text: Time-gradient sense: perceives time-dilation gradients in the dome and forages in fast zones when hungry
items.category: NOVEL-100 / D. Senses beyond the usual

items.text: Mutation-rate sense: senses its own somatic mutation rate under radiation and seeks shelter
items.category: NOVEL-100 / D. Senses beyond the usual

items.text: Self-entrainment: chooses its light exposure to phase-shift itself ahead of predicted food windows
items.category: NOVEL-100 / D. Senses beyond the usual

items.text: Gravity-anomaly memory: stores places by local gravity anomalies
items.category: NOVEL-100 / D. Senses beyond the usual

items.text: Fidelity touch: senses the similarity (fidelity) of a peer's qubit state to its own at contact
items.category: NOVEL-100 / D. Senses beyond the usual

items.text: Illusion unlearning: falls for designed dome illusions, then learns to see through them
items.category: NOVEL-100 / D. Senses beyond the usual

items.text: Voluntary percept flips: flips its own bistable percept on demand when it pays
items.category: NOVEL-100 / D. Senses beyond the usual

items.text: Dream-seeded germline: REM-sampled motor programs that worked awake are favoured in gametes
items.category: NOVEL-100 / E. Sleep, dreams and heredity

items.text: Shared dreaming: creatures asleep in contact exchange replay sequences, so a listener learns routes it never walked
items.category: NOVEL-100 / E. Sleep, dreams and heredity

items.text: Threat-calibrated nightmares: REM rehearses dangers in proportion to the hell-ladder rung
items.category: NOVEL-100 / E. Sleep, dreams and heredity

items.text: Lucid REM: detects that it is dreaming from impossible states and steers the dream towards its open uncertainty
items.category: NOVEL-100 / E. Sleep, dreams and heredity

items.text: REM uncertainty maps: REM writes uncertainty (not values) into a map that guides the next day's exploration
items.category: NOVEL-100 / E. Sleep, dreams and heredity

items.text: Dream-born signals: new signals invented in dreams spread through waking culture
items.category: NOVEL-100 / E. Sleep, dreams and heredity

items.text: Uncertainty-set somatic mutation: the sleep-time mutation rate rises with unresolved uncertainty
items.category: NOVEL-100 / E. Sleep, dreams and heredity

items.text: Inherited dreams: offspring dreams replay parental experiences (epigenetic replay)
items.category: NOVEL-100 / E. Sleep, dreams and heredity

items.text: Dormant dreaming: dreams continue during dormancy and update the world model, so it wakes ready
items.category: NOVEL-100 / E. Sleep, dreams and heredity

items.text: Quantum dream audit: dream diversity under Moonlab vs PRNG sampling, with a preregistered null
items.category: NOVEL-100 / E. Sleep, dreams and heredity

items.text: Skill market: creatures trade partial neural snapshots (skills) for food
items.category: NOVEL-100 / F. Social, trade and culture

items.text: Neural grafting with rejection: integrates a peer's partial state; the immune layer rejects incompatible grafts
items.category: NOVEL-100 / F. Social, trade and culture

items.text: Cryptographic kin check: verifies a peer's claimed lineage hash before cooperating
items.category: NOVEL-100 / F. Social, trade and culture

items.text: Sleep-schedule culture: groups converge on shared sleep timing by observation, beyond the light cycle
items.category: NOVEL-100 / F. Social, trade and culture

items.text: Teaching into sleep: an elder signals a route while a juvenile sleeps, and the juvenile wakes knowing it
items.category: NOVEL-100 / F. Social, trade and culture

items.text: Group Markov blanket under threat: a group's statistical boundary appears only under threat
items.category: NOVEL-100 / F. Social, trade and culture

items.text: Collective dial estimation: a group pools estimates of God-panel changes
items.category: NOVEL-100 / F. Social, trade and culture

items.text: Skin-colour dialects: shader-skin colour patterns become signals that drift into group dialects
items.category: NOVEL-100 / F. Social, trade and culture

items.text: Honest costly signals priced by the ledger: signal cost is exact energy, so receivers learn honesty
items.category: NOVEL-100 / F. Social, trade and culture

items.text: Inter-species debt: 001 and a second species keep exchange balances over days
items.category: NOVEL-100 / F. Social, trade and culture

items.text: Eversion defence: turns itself inside out to change which tissue faces toxins
items.category: NOVEL-100 / G. Body and morphology

items.text: Cavity voice: tunes body-cavity resonance to change its voice; cavity size evolves
items.category: NOVEL-100 / G. Body and morphology

items.text: Translucency control: adjusts body translucency for camouflage vs display
items.category: NOVEL-100 / G. Body and morphology

items.text: Organ exchange: two creatures swap an organ module and both re-adapt
items.category: NOVEL-100 / G. Body and morphology

items.text: Bioelectric limb vote: the number of limbs grown is set by a bioelectric vote of body regions
items.category: NOVEL-100 / G. Body and morphology

items.text: Posture memory: body posture stores a short-term memory
items.category: NOVEL-100 / G. Body and morphology

items.text: Famine autotomy with ledgered regrowth: sheds limbs to save energy and regrows when fed
items.category: NOVEL-100 / G. Body and morphology

items.text: Gravity reshaping: body proportions shift within life in response to the gravity dial
items.category: NOVEL-100 / G. Body and morphology

items.text: Body-plan dreams: REM simulates alternative bodies and steers bioelectric growth
items.category: NOVEL-100 / G. Body and morphology

items.text: Seven-eye parallax depth: depth from 7 non-coplanar eyes with a learned geometry
items.category: NOVEL-100 / G. Body and morphology

items.text: Shading engineering: creatures shade patches to steer grazers and food growth
items.category: NOVEL-100 / H. Ecology of the dome

items.text: Ladder acclimation: populations adapt to their hell-ladder rung over generations
items.category: NOVEL-100 / H. Ecology of the dome

items.text: Utopia decay: under utopia, capabilities decay from relaxed selection
items.category: NOVEL-100 / H. Ecology of the dome

items.text: Parasite manipulation: parasites evolve to change host foraging to their benefit
items.category: NOVEL-100 / H. Ecology of the dome

items.text: Time-niche species: species specialise in dilated or frozen time zones
items.category: NOVEL-100 / H. Ecology of the dome

items.text: Berry-stamped caches: food caches are remembered with geometric-phase timestamps
items.category: NOVEL-100 / H. Ecology of the dome

items.text: God-dice predator learning: learns the statistics of dice-driven disasters and pre-empts them
items.category: NOVEL-100 / H. Ecology of the dome

items.text: Dome-scale criticality: the whole ecosystem self-tunes to a critical point
items.category: NOVEL-100 / H. Ecology of the dome

items.text: Culture migration between domes: migrants carry traditions to another dome
items.category: NOVEL-100 / H. Ecology of the dome

items.category: NOVEL-100 / H. Ecology of the dome

items.category: NOVEL-100 / I. Metacognition and self-model

items.text: Measured self-model depth: decodes level-2 (confidence about confidence) and level-3 representations
items.category: NOVEL-100 / I. Metacognition and self-model

items.text: Knows it slept: reports elapsed sleep duration and stage mix from its own traces
items.category: NOVEL-100 / I. Metacognition and self-model

items.text: Pre-symptomatic self-diagnosis: predicts organ failure from interoceptive patterns before symptoms
items.category: NOVEL-100 / I. Metacognition and self-model

items.text: Signals carrying its own confidence: peers use the confidence it signals
items.category: NOVEL-100 / I. Metacognition and self-model

items.text: Known unknowns about God: tracks which dials it cannot predict and avoids reliance on them
items.category: NOVEL-100 / I. Metacognition and self-model

items.text: Measured strange loop: the self-symbol's influence on the dynamics it models is measured as closed-loop gain
items.category: NOVEL-100 / I. Metacognition and self-model

items.text: Self-model through metamorphosis: keeps and remaps its self-model across a body rebuild
items.category: NOVEL-100 / I. Metacognition and self-model

items.category: NOVEL-100 / I. Metacognition and self-model

items.text: Energy futures: commits stores against predicted seasons and dial changes
items.category: NOVEL-100 / J. Energy and physiology

items.text: Ketosis cognition mode: cognition style switches with ketosis (slower, more exploratory)
items.category: NOVEL-100 / J. Energy and physiology

items.text: Thermal thinking schedule: schedules costly thinking for temperature windows where cognition is cheap
items.category: NOVEL-100 / J. Energy and physiology

items.text: Neuron triage in famine: prunes least-used neurons under famine and regrows them when fed
items.category: NOVEL-100 / J. Energy and physiology

items.text: Hormone-coded valence memory: episode valence stored in slow hormone pulses
items.category: NOVEL-100 / J. Energy and physiology

items.text: Fever for learning: immune fever raises plasticity to learn the cause of an illness
items.category: NOVEL-100 / J. Energy and physiology

items.text: Microbiome-written dreams: gut flora signals change dream content
items.category: NOVEL-100 / J. Energy and physiology

items.text: Entropy circadian: the entropy of its Moonlab draws follows a circadian rhythm it controls
items.category: NOVEL-100 / J. Energy and physiology

items.text: Ledgered honesty audit: it can show any peer the exact ledger of a claimed meal
items.category: NOVEL-100 / J. Energy and physiology

items.text: Starvation-ordered memory sacrifice: under starvation it gives up the least-valuable memories first
